title: Nilpotent invariance beyond quasi-coherent coefficients
as_he_states: Can the quasi-coherence-type assumption on F be removed?
plausible_today: Keep a cartesian coefficient system with finite-level acyclicity and a countable derived-complete/ML evaluation tower; then the same completion comparison is a precise sufficient formulation.
state_of_art: Grothendieck1968 §5.3 gives the restricted argument; Liu2025 addresses crystal coefficients, not a theorem for every sheaf.
why_open: No historical reason for abandonment is stated in the supplied pages or opened sources; the limit/acyclicity issue is our diagnosis.
worth: Worth a focused categorical formulation, because the missing hypotheses can be stated and tested explicitly.

title: Intrinsic analytic completed-diagonal Poincaré lemma
as_he_states: For every complex analytic space, the written completed-diagonal complex resolves C.
plausible_today: For finite-type complex schemes, the completed algebraic diagonal computes Betti cohomology; a local analytic comparison to the ambient formal de Rham resolution is the precise remaining bridge in the literal formulation.
state_of_art: Grothendieck1968 Conj5.1; Hartshorne1975 IV.2.1 (ambient analytic complex); Bhatt2012 Cor4.30 and Example4.23 (flat noetherian algebraic case).
why_open: The sources do not give a reason this exact intrinsic analytic formulation was dropped. Grothendieck’s formal-fiber heuristic leaves a completion-exactness step; that is a mathematical diagnosis, not documentary history.
worth: Worth checking the exact analytic comparison literature before starting a new proof, because closely related algebraic and ambient results are established.

title: Flat infinitesimal–stratifying comparison with coefficients
as_he_states: For X/S flat locally finitely presented and usual compatible F, prove the site comparison; equivalently nilpotent invariance.
plausible_today: For finite-type flat maps of noetherian Q-schemes, the O-coefficient statement holds; general crystals require a separate coefficient theorem.
state_of_art: Bhatt2012 Cor4.30 matches the structure-coefficient case. Liu2025 Theorem11.2 compares infinitesimal crystal cohomology with an ambient de Rham complex but is not automatically an intrinsic stratifying result.
why_open: No documented abandonment reason. Failure of the formal-smooth covering argument for merely flat maps is explicit on scan62.
worth: Worth developing only the coefficient extension after proving a precise category comparison, rather than reproving the known O case.

title: Nonarchimedean local exactness and convergence
as_he_states: Ask whether the earlier local conjecture holds for the partially cancelled nonarchimedean analytic category.
plausible_today: Fix a topology and a function sheaf, distinguishing convergent, overconvergent and formal functions; no unconditional universal statement is extracted.
state_of_art: Opened crystalline/infinitesimal comparisons do not identify the cancelled category. The supplied earlier-run analytic example is independently rechecked and rules out naive global integration on a closed Tate disc.
why_open: The manuscript itself says the global implications would be less remarkable; no other reason is evidenced.
worth: Worth only after recovering the precise intended topology from the ink and neighboring papers.
